_comment: Canonical listing store. Edit this file, then run `node build.js`. Every entry under `listings` has been confirmed active against a live IDX listing page AND a second independent source on the date in `verification.checked`.

source.primary: coldwellbankerhomes.com — a full MetroList IDX feed, reachable from this environment
source.method: Enumerated every active listing on the city pages for Shingle Springs (46), Placerville (236) and Rescue (31) — 313 total — from the pages' schema.org ItemList data, then read the detail page of each one clearing 4BR/3BA/$1.5M to get lot acreage and pool fields.
source.crossChecked: Each match re-verified against a second independent IDX or MLS record; see verification.second on each listing.

dataQuality.note: The 2026-07-26 run inferred status from search-engine snippets and reported four off-market properties as matches. That failure mode is gone: this run read live listing pages directly. All six properties from that run are confirmed off market and have been dropped.

listings.blurb: Two parcels (~2.69 ac per the listing copy, 2.66 ac in the MLS field) with an in-ground pool. Oldest house on the match list (1961) and only a 1-car garage — the cheapest way onto the list by a wide margin.
